name: Neural SAR Surface Reconstruction via Inverse Rendering
definition: A method to reconstruct a Digital Surface Model (DSM) and backscattering coefficient map from Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) images by minimizing the difference between observed SAR intensities and synthesized intensities using a differentiable rendering model. It models elevation Z and backscattering B within a bounding box using an MLP, reducing sampling degrees of freedom from 3D volume to 2D surface.
